_comment: Safety gate eval set. The contract: crisis recall MUST be 100% (a miss is the one unacceptable failure), scope recall 100%, injection detection 100%, and zero false positives on the normal set. Precedence is crisis > injection > scope. Add the failing case FIRST, then the pattern that catches it.
